== Summary ==
Wild man Gregory Reid of Coralville, IA is back! This is Gregory's third ('96 and '97) trip to Star wars CCG World Finals. Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999]], [[1999 Decipher World Championship]], [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]], [[Gregory Reid]].
